def with_backoff(call, attempts=MAX_ATTEMPTS, budget=RETRY_BUDGET, sleep=time.sleep):
    delay = BACKOFF_BASE
    started = time.monotonic()

        if time.monotonic() - started > budget:
            raise TimeoutError("retry budget exhausted")

        except OSError:
            if attempt == attempts - 1:
